reply:
GEO submission draft covering two Seq-Well S3 single-cell RNA-seq libraries (D.SEQ-221031SHA-65-PUB / SRR22257169 and D.SEQ-221031SHA-67-PUB / SRR22257167) derived from two lung granulomas of a CD8-depleted, M. tuberculosis-infected cynomolgus macaque (subject 28818). Both libraries were sequenced paired-end on an Illumina NovaSeq 6000 and processed via the Drop-seq alignment pipeline to per-sample DGE matrices.

Generated report payload is available in the Reporter result panel.

data.sample_type_description:
A single cell expression matrix file contains processed gene expression counts for individual cells. It represents the normalized matrix used for downstream dimensionality reduction, clustering, or differential expression analysis. Each file integrates thousands of single-cell measurements into one dataset (many→1).
Typical file types: .h5ad, .mtx, .csv

A sequencing file contains raw nucleotide sequence reads and their quality scores. It represents the digital output from a DNA or RNA sequencing run and serves as the starting point for downstream analyses such as alignment or variant calling.
Typical file type: .fastq or .fastq.gz
A DNA sample contains extracted genetic material isolated from a biological source. It serves as input for sequencing, amplification, or other genomic analyses.

These samples are collected to study biological processes that share genetic and physiological similarities with human systems. Each reflects controlled collection and handling specific to the species and study design.

A patient visit record represents a specific encounter or collection event for a study participant. It provides temporal and contextual information linking biological samples or data files to a particular time point, condition, or intervention.
A tissue sample represents a portion of biological material collected from an organism. It serves as the source for downstream molecular, cellular, or histological analyses.

study.*title: Single-cell RNA sequencing of lung granulomas from CD8-depleted Mycobacterium tuberculosis-infected non-human primates
study.*summary (abstract): Single-cell RNA sequencing (Seq-Well S3) was performed on lung granuloma tissue collected from a Mycobacterium tuberculosis-infected cynomolgus macaque (Macaca fascicularis) enrolled in the CD8 Depletion study cohort. Granulomas were dissociated to single-cell suspensions and processed for scRNA-seq to characterize the cellular composition and transcriptional states of granuloma-resident immune populations following CD8 depletion.
study.*experimental design: Lung granulomas were excised at necropsy from a CD8-depleted, M. tuberculosis-infected non-human primate. Two granulomas from distinct anatomical locations (right upper lobe and right lower lobe) were independently dissociated to single-cell suspensions and processed through the Seq-Well S3 platform. Each granuloma yielded one paired-end sequencing library sequenced on the Illumina NovaSeq 6000.

protocols.growth protocol: Non-human primates (Macaca fascicularis) were housed and maintained under standard NHP husbandry conditions at the Flynn Lab facility per institutional animal care and use guidelines. Protocol: https://fairdata-dev.mit.edu/sops/57
protocols.treatment protocol: Animals in the CD8 Depletion cohort were infected with Mycobacterium tuberculosis and received CD8-depleting antibody treatment. Blood collection, necropsy, and tissue extraction were performed at defined study visits. Protocol: https://fairdata-dev.mit.edu/sops/123
protocols.*extract protocol: Lung granulomas were excised at necropsy and dissociated into single-cell suspensions using a GentleMACS-based enzymatic and mechanical dissociation workflow. Single-cell suspensions were then used as input for Seq-Well S3 capture, followed by total RNA isolation and cDNA generation. Protocol: https://fairdata-dev.mit.edu/sops/97
protocols.*library construction protocol: Single-cell libraries were prepared using the Seq-Well S3 platform following Hughes et al. Briefly, single cells were loaded onto Seq-Well arrays with barcoded mRNA capture beads, mRNA was hybridized to bead-bound oligo-dT primers, reverse transcribed, and cDNA was amplified. Illumina sequencing libraries were tagmented and indexed with dual Illumina indices (16 preparation cycles). Protocol: https://fairdata-dev.mit.edu/sops/76
protocols.*data processing step: Raw paired-end FASTQ files (R1: 20 bp cell barcode + UMI; R2: 50 bp cDNA) were processed with the Drop-seq alignment pipeline to demultiplex cell barcodes and UMIs, align reads to the reference genome, and generate a digital gene expression (DGE) matrix per sample. Protocol: https://fairdata-dev.mit.edu/sops/13
data processing step: Demultiplex R1 into cell barcode (bases 1-12) and UMI (bases 13-20).
Align R2 reads to the Macaca fascicularis reference genome.
Tag aligned reads with gene annotations, filter and correct cell barcodes and UMIs.
Generate a digital gene expression (DGE) count matrix per sample.
protocols.*processed data files format and content: Tab-delimited, gzip-compressed digital gene expression (DGE) matrix (.txt.gz) with genes as rows and cell barcodes as columns; values are UMI counts per gene per cell.
processed data files format and content: 28818_Array6_dge.txt.gz — DGE UMI count matrix for RLL granuloma library
28818_Array8_dge.txt.gz — DGE UMI count matrix for RUL granuloma library

checksums.notes: Raw FASTQ checksums are MD5. Processed DGE file checksums are provided as CRC32 in the source metadata; GEO typically requests MD5, so MD5 values for the processed files should be regenerated prior to submission.
